snippet.title: Pachitte Chonmage Tatsujin 2: CR Jurassic Park - PlayStation 2 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Yes, there really was a Japan-exclusive Pachinko game for PlayStation 2 based on Jurassic Park, released back in 2003.

Jurassic Park (C) Universal Studios / Amblin Entertainment
Developed and published by Hack Berry
